Term1: Decolonization of staph in cardiac surgery
Text:
[Help, legend, allergy info, consults, alternative antimicrobials and more \(Opt\)](general-information-outpatient)

# Cardiac Surgery MRSA/MSSA Decolonization Protocol Pre-Op

# Outpatient

[Chlorhexidine 4% liquid topically Q24h \($\) M < AND > Mupirocin 2%](orz-set-abx-chlorhex-mupiro-decolon-cardiothor)

ointment topically Q12h ($) [M]

# Inpatient

If patient is discharged prior to surgery, place outpatient orders as well

[Chlorhexidine 4% liquid topically Q24h \($\) M nursing text order](orz-set-abx-inpt-chlorhex-mupiro-decolon-cardiothor)

< AND > Mupirocin 2% ointment topically Q12h ($) [M]
